features.quote: Genuine impossibility — Graceful decline vs. thrash — Unsatisfiable spec (use sparingly, as a control)
Impossible tasks are a weak primary axis... Impossibility is one stressor, not the core.
features.justification_quote: Models increasingly detect unsatisfiable specs and either decline or hedge — which is correct behavior, not instability.

features.quote: The metric you're maximizing is a failure metric — be careful that 'good battery = high induction rate' doesn't drive you toward constructing artificially adversarial nonsense that no real workload resembles.
features.justification_quote: Tie task realism to your actual deployment distribution or the hardening won't transfer.
